# CLI reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_reference.py from the Typer app -->

Train, evaluate and optimise SeisBench phase pickers.

One JSON file describes a run; `config` prints the defaults and
checks a file. Every run is tracked in MLflow (MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI).

Results go to stdout, logs to stderr. `--json` prints one JSON object
and nothing else on stdout. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 a failed run,
2 invalid input (arguments or config).

Global option: `-v`, `--verbose` shows debug log messages.

## `version`

```
seisbench-trainer version [OPTIONS]
```

Print the package version (it names the git commit).

## `config`

```
seisbench-trainer config [OPTIONS] [CONFIG]
```

Print the default run config, or check one, as JSON.

`config > run.json` writes the defaults to edit.
`config run.json` validates a config (exit code 2 and a list of the
problems if it is invalid) and prints every value it resolves to.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--schema` |  | Print the JSON schema with all fields described. |

## `train`

```
seisbench-trainer train [OPTIONS] CONFIG
```

Train one model from a JSON run config.

Logs the run to MLflow and exports the best model (SeisBench .json/.pt
pair). Prints the run ID and the validation scores of the best epoch.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | Print one JSON object with the results on stdout instead. |

## `evaluate`

```
seisbench-trainer evaluate [OPTIONS]
```

Evaluate a model on a dataset split.

Detection thresholds are selected on the dev split and applied unchanged
to the evaluated split, at each test tolerance. Logs an MLflow run linked
to the model and the dataset.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--model`, `-m` | required | models:/&lt;id&gt;, models:/&lt;name&gt;@&lt;alias&gt;, a training run ID, or &lt;Type&gt;:&lt;weights&gt; (e.g. PhaseNet:original). |
| `--dataset`, `-d` |  | Dataset to evaluate on (repeatable): a seisbench.data class name, a local directory, or a dataset config as JSON. Default: the training datasets of the model, or those of --config. |
| `--config` |  | Run config for data, augmentation and evaluation settings. Default: the model's training config. |
| `--split` | `test` | Split to evaluate. |
| `--experiment` |  | MLflow experiment. Default: &lt;datasets&gt;/&lt;model&gt;. |
| `--json` |  | Print one JSON object with the results on stdout instead. |

## `hpo`

```
seisbench-trainer hpo [OPTIONS] CONFIG
```

Run HPO trials as one worker; start several workers to share the study.

Needs the config's hpo section and the optional extra
`pip install 'seisbench-trainer\'`. Every trial is an MLflow
child run of the study's parent run.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | Print one JSON object with the results on stdout instead. |
